# Menus 226, 228 and 231 (delete all lip, eye, and eyebrow frames) on
# inputs/face4.pmx, which has one morph per lane. Each lane gets keys at
# frames 10, 20, 30 first.
load model face4.pmx
select morph 0 真面目
select morph 1 まばたき
select morph 2 あ
select morph 3 照れ
frame 10
morph 0 0.25
morph 1 0.25
morph 2 0.25
morph 3 0.25
register morph 0
register morph 1
register morph 2
register morph 3
frame 20
morph 0 1
morph 1 1
morph 2 1
morph 3 1
register morph 0
register morph 1
register morph 2
register morph 3
frame 30
morph 0 0.5
morph 1 0.5
morph 2 0.5
morph 3 0.5
register morph 0
register morph 1
register morph 2
register morph 3
save pmm registered.pmm
select all morph
save vmd registered.vmd
delete lip
save pmm lip-deleted.pmm
select all morph
save vmd lip-deleted.vmd
delete eye
save pmm eye-deleted.pmm
select all morph
save vmd eye-deleted.vmd
delete eyebrow
save pmm eyebrow-deleted.pmm
select all morph
save vmd eyebrow-deleted.vmd
